theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {κ : Cardinal.{w}} [Fact κ.IsRegular] [CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory C κ] (X : C) : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered (CategoryTheory.CostructuredArrow (CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ).ι X) κ := by
  have h1 : CategoryTheory.HasColimitsOfSize C κ :=
    CategoryTheory.IsCardinalAccessibleCategory.toHasCardinalFilteredColimits C κ
  let P := CategoryTheory.isCardinalPresentable C κ
  have h2 : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalFiltered P.ι :=
    CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isCardinalFiltered_costructuredArrow_colimitsCardinalClosure_ι P κ h1 X
  exact h2
